verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent works inside ticketing systems as a team member. It can take real actions through tools, such as Stripe refunds gated by guardrails, which supports end-to-end resolution rather than mere deflection. The Internal Agent can also report on how the Customer Agent is performing. However, nothing documents a resolution-rate metric, any share of conversations actually resolved, or a way of separating resolutions from deflections or bounces. Missing for 10: documented resolution-rate metrics that distinguish resolutions from deflections, evidence of the share of conversations fully resolved, and independent or customer corroboration of resolution outcomes.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: Your Customer Agent works as a team member in Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon.
Tools can use any service with an API: public integrations like Stripe, or your own internal endpoints.
Require Slack approval before the refund tool runs on amounts above $100.
Prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short.
